# photo-gallery defaults. The extension reads them from

extensions:

    thumbnail-quality: 88
    gap: 5
    show-exif: true
    show-date: true
    show-download: true
    show-bullets: false
    date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
    transition: zoom
---
